title: Pluto
text: Pluto lost its official status as a planet yesterday, when the International Astronomical Union downsized the solar system from 9 to 8 planets. Although there had been passionate debate at the IAU General Assembly Meeting in Prague about the definition of a planet and whether Pluto met the specifications the audience greeted the decision to exclude it with applause.

title: Immense Disparity
text: The core of the problem was the immense disparity between the country's productive capacity and the ability of people to consume. Great innovations in productive techniques during and after the war raised the output of industry beyond the purchasing capacity of U.S. farmers and wage earners.
